name: Dousoukai ~Yesterday Once More~
source:
One day an invitation arrives from a friend who was with you in the tennis club when you were in middle school. It is an invitation to the reunion of the tennis club members. You have one week. You can either go for your first love, or find another love, or become a cupid for others...

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=457&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
一天，你收到初中网球部朋友寄来的邀请函，邀请你参加昔日部员的同学会。你有一周时间，可以选择追求初恋，寻找新的爱情，或是为他人牵线搭桥…

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=457&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
